description: Three dark themes inspired by CONTROL and CONTROL Resonant (Dark, Black/OLED and Resonant), with optional, original sound effects for VS Code events. Fan-made, not affiliated with Remedy Entertainment.
config.sounds.title: CONTROL Theme — Sounds
config.sounds.enabled: Play optional sound effects inspired by CONTROL and CONTROL Resonant. **Off by default.** Each event can be turned on or off individually under *CONTROL Theme — Sound Events*.
config.sounds.pack.auto: Follow the active theme: CONTROL Resonant uses the Resonant pack, the other themes use the Control pack.
config.sounds.pack.control: Always use the Control pack (The Oldest House).
config.sounds.pack.resonant: Always use the Resonant pack (patterned Manhattan).
config.sounds.onlyWithControlTheme: Only play sounds while one of the CONTROL themes is active.
config.sounds.errorTrigger: When to check for new errors.
config.sounds.errorTrigger.onSave: After saving a file (recommended: errors that appear while you type do not make noise).
config.sounds.errorTrigger.live: As soon as the error count changes, after a short pause.
config.sounds.cooldownMs: Minimum time between two sounds, in milliseconds. More important sounds (errors, failed builds) can still interrupt less important ones.
config.sounds.customFolder: Folder with your own `.wav` files. Use the same file names as the built-in packs (`startup.wav`, `theme.wav`, `save.wav`, `error.wav`, `clear.wav`, `build-ok.wav`, `build-fail.wav`, `terminal-fail.wav`, `debug.wav`, `breakpoint.wav`, `commit.wav`). Missing files fall back to the selected pack. The extension never includes or downloads third-party audio.
config.events.title: CONTROL Theme — Sound Events
config.events.themeActivated: When you switch to a CONTROL theme.
config.events.save: When you save a file manually (auto-save is ignored).
config.events.allClear: When the last error is fixed.
config.events.buildSuccess: When a task (build, test…) finishes successfully.
config.events.terminalFail: When a terminal command fails (requires shell integration).
config.events.breakpoint: When the debugger stops at a breakpoint.
config.events.gitCommit: When you make a Git commit.
